checks.title: Confirm written scope and owners
checks.instructions: Record written target, environment, allowed methods, time window, rate and side-effect limits, stop conditions, restricted evidence policy, Security and closure owners, and excluded actions.

checks.title: Bind exact finding and asset
checks.instructions: Record tenant, finding, asset, affected environment, observed build, source report, component, current disposition, stable deduplication key and retest target.

checks.title: Set applicability and severity rules
checks.instructions: Record policy revision, verification limits, scanner-only versus confirmed status, exposure and impact evidence, confidence, due date, and accepted-risk authority.

checks.title: Define fix and independent retest
checks.instructions: Specify reviewed change path, expected fixed build, affected deployment source, finding-specific retest criterion, independent reviewer, closure authority, and risk-acceptance expiry rule.

checks.title: Bind ready Security Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect existing compatible Crews. Bind ready Security Findings Analyst and Security Remediation Coordinator IDs and selected skills; separate them when assessment, change authority or independent review requires it.

checks.title: Probe real records
checks.instructions: Read one authorized finding and affected asset/build, relevant issue or source record, current deployment and an appropriate retest source. A named scanner or repository is not verified access.

checks.title: Validate finding and remediation join
checks.instructions: Run the bundled validator before Remediation consumes Finding. Reject wrong tenant, finding, asset or environment, unsupported applicability, missing scope proof, false deployed claims, retest on a different build, and unsupported closure.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source and artifact paths, explicit validator steps, permissions, scope and stop conditions, owner decisions, change/deployment/retest routes, privacy limits, duplicate policy, cost and manual route before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run one authorized case manually
checks.instructions: Use a real finding within written scope. Save source and validator IDs, owner decisions, actual change/deployment/retest status, closure or unknown, and blockers. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose event and action ledger
checks.instructions: Choose manual-only or a reviewed authenticated finding event with stable IDs, replay protection, retries, cost and notifications. Setup completion alone enables no scan, ticket, change, deployment or closure.
